description: List the workspace's WIPE JOBS (public.entries_wipe_jobs, #2147) — the ONE source of truth for wipe progress, the same rows the dashboard's wipe banner renders. Each job: the EXACT device set, the narrowing predicate (hosts/methods/status_class/search_q/origin), total (from the live entry_dh_counts ledger; total_exact=false ⇒ an upper bound), deleted, percent, status (queued|running|done|failed|cancelled), started/finished/heartbeat timestamps, requested_by, error, plus derived `stalled` (no heartbeat for 90 s — the server re-drive resumes it within a minute) and `terminal`. Filters: job_id, status (or 'active' = queued|running), device_uuid (jobs touching that device). Newest first, capped 100. Read-only.

status.description: queued | running | done | failed | cancelled | active
